title: LibreOffice can import documents in the HWP format, including pictures that link to an external file. (CVE-2026-98100)
description: A vulnerability in LibreOffice's HWP document import feature allows an out-of-bounds read when processing pictures that link to external files. This flaw can cause memory beyond the picture data to be included in the converted document. The issue is addressed in fixed versions by restricting the link target extraction to the picture data only.
